name: MonarchWorkspaceSwitcher
title: WorkspaceSwitcher
wrapsNative: Button presenting a .popover (kept a popover on iPhone with presentationCompactAdaptation) with a search field, avatar rows with the @handle, Create workspace and All workspaces; MonarchButtonStyle (.ghost), MonarchAvatar, Link
summary: Switches between the workspaces a person belongs to from a button with the workspace's logo, name and handle, which opens a popover with a search field, the workspaces with their @handles, Create workspace and All workspaces.
whenToUse: In an app used across several workspaces: in the navigation bar, a sidebar header or the account screen, wherever the current workspace is switched.
whenNotToUse: To narrow a workspace to one of its Spaces use MonarchSpaceSwitcher. To pick a workspace inside a form use MonarchCombobox.
api: init(selection: Binding<String?>, workspaces: [MonarchWorkspaceOption], size: MonarchButtonSize = .md, isLoading: Bool = false, isIconOnly: Bool = false, manageURL: URL? = nil, labels: MonarchWorkspaceSwitcherLabels = MonarchWorkspaceSwitcherLabels(), onCreate: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
struct MonarchWorkspaceOption { init(id: String, name: String, handle: String? = nil, avatarURL: URL? = nil, keywords: String? = nil) }
struct MonarchWorkspaceSwitcherLabels { init(label:, placeholder:, search:, empty:, loading:, create:, manage:, cancel:) }

options.name: selection
options.description: The current workspace id, nil when none is chosen. The app switches when it changes.

options.name: workspaces
options.description: The workspaces this person belongs to, in display order.

options.name: size
options.description: The height and padding of the button.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: The workspaces are still loading: the button opens the sheet, which shows a progress indicator with Loading workspaces.

options.name: isIconOnly
options.description: Shows only the logo and the chevron, for a narrow bar. The name stays the spoken value.

options.name: manageURL
options.description: Adds All workspaces, a Link that opens this URL.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Adds Create workspace, which runs this (after closing the sheet).

states.name: menu
states.description: Up to five loaded workspaces: a system menu with the workspaces as an inline picker (the current one checked), then a divider and the actions.

states.name: sheet
states.description: More than five workspaces, or loading: a sheet with a searchable list of logos, names and handles, the current one checked.

states.name: nothing chosen
states.description: The button shows a building symbol and Choose a workspace.

states.name: searching
states.description: The sheet keeps the workspaces whose name, handle or keywords contain the text; with no match it reads No workspaces match.

states.name: loading
states.description: The sheet ends with a progress indicator and Loading workspaces.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Through disabled(_:), the ghost button style's disabled colours; the menu or sheet cannot open.

appearance: A ghost MonarchButtonStyle button: a small square MonarchAvatar (logo or initials), the name in the default text colour, the handle and an up-down chevron in the muted text colour. The menu is the system menu; the sheet is a system inset List with avatars, caption handles in the muted text colour and an accent check mark. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The popover is drawn by Monarch, as the web's, so the search field, the avatars and the @handle column are inside it; the system menu cannot hold them. On iPhone it stays a popover from the button (presentationCompactAdaptation) and the same view serves a long list: it filters as the person types and shows a loading row while the list loads. VoiceOver reads each row as the workspace name with its handle and whether it is current.
accessibility: The button is one element named "Workspace" whose value is the workspace's name and handle ("Acme, @acme"), built by a tested pure function, also when only the logo shows.
In the menu the workspaces are a system Picker, so VoiceOver reads the chosen one as selected.
In the sheet each row is a button named by the name and handle; the chosen row has the selected trait and a check mark.
Rows and actions keep a 44-point touch target.
Choosing the current workspace again changes nothing.
edgeCases: A selected id that is not in workspaces reads Choose a workspace.
A handle given with or without its @ is shown with one @.
Search also matches keywords, which are never shown, such as an old name.
With no workspaces and nothing loading the menu holds only the actions.
